_note: Fault-board ordering table. Every rule below is a heuristic, adjustable: edit tiers/matches here, no code change. The first rule (lowest tier number) whose match holds decides a card's tier; ties inside a tier are broken by the tiebreak list.
label: heuristic, adjustable

rules.name: Safety system, present now
rules.rationale: A brake, steering or airbag fault that is failing now can hurt someone; it outranks everything.

rules.name: Warning lamp (MIL) requested
rules.rationale: The car is asking for the lamp; the owner sees it and an inspection will fail.

rules.name: Came back after a fix
rules.rationale: A repair that did not hold means the diagnosis was wrong; look again before touching anything else.

rules.name: Permanent code (Mode 0A)
rules.rationale: Cannot be cleared by a scan tool; only the car passing its own monitor removes it.

rules.name: Active now
rules.rationale: Test failing in the last read.

rules.name: Pending
rules.rationale: Failed once this drive cycle; not yet confirmed.

rules.name: Fix marked, waiting for proof
rules.rationale: Someone said fixed; CUORE still owes the proof.

rules.name: Safety system, stored history
rules.rationale: Not failing now but on a system where a repeat matters.

rules.name: Stored history
rules.rationale: Seen before, not present in the latest read.

rules.name: Proven fixed
rules.rationale: Evidence says it is gone; kept only for the record.

rules.name: Resolved
rules.rationale: Closed by the mechanic or owner; last.

tiebreak: most recently seen first (owner rule: priority, then most recent)
more times returned after a clear first
